title: A sunscreen model has spectral bands, not one universal shield factor
title_de: Ein Sonnenschutzmodell besitzt Spektralbänder statt eines universellen Schutzfaktors
question: Does the same declared formulation attenuate UVA, UVB and visible input according to different model bands?
script:
# D3-LI-007: A sunscreen model has spectral bands, not one universal shield factor
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
new
new
new
add v1 sunscreen 1g
add v2 sunscreen 1g
add v3 sunscreen 1g
add v4 water 1g
irradiate v1 305nm 1W/m2
irradiate v2 365nm 1W/m2
irradiate v3 550nm 1W/m2
irradiate v4 305nm 1W/m2
look v1
look v2
look v3
look v4
inspect
expected_result: Review band-specific incident and transmitted-state information rather than assigning the UVB protection factor to every wavelength. The water-only vessel is a formulation-omission control.
limitations: This is a standard-film teaching model: it does not predict applied thickness, skin exposure, safety, photostability, or the protection of any real commercial product.
